lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7 to 8 distinct white vertical lines are visible across the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-section, with line height decreasing and density slightly increasing toward the posterior boundary.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line near the shoulder and the final posterior line near the haunch are abbreviated segments that do not span the full vertical height of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 to 10 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior haunch, positioned above the junction of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lower haunch show a near-vertical alignment, paralleling the trajectory of the posterior torso lines.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory with a spiral twist, moving laterally from the base before curving medially and anteriorly toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 1.25 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips represent approximately 15% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Red-billed Oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) on the dorsal-anterior torso and neck. Prominent white facial markings include a bridge chevron and two distinct malar/cheek spots.
